UPDATE leads
SET
    status = 'failed',
    error_message = COALESCE($2::text, 'Retry execution failed'),
    next_retry_at = CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < 3
         AND (
             $2 ILIKE '%503%'
             OR $2 ILIKE '%429%'
             OR $2 ILIKE '%timeout%'
             OR $2 ILIKE '%temporarily unavailable%'
         )
        THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes'
        ELSE NULL
    END
WHERE execution_id = $1
  AND status = 'processing'
RETURNING
    lead_id,
    status,
    retry_count,
    next_retry_at,
    error_message;
